elements.requirement: An employer must pay a redundancy payment to any employee of that employer if the employee is dismissed by the employer by reason of redundancy.
elements.quote: An employer shall pay a redundancy payment to any employee of his if the employee— (a) is dismissed by the employer by reason of redundancy

elements.requirement: An employer must pay a redundancy payment to any employee of that employer if the employee is eligible for a redundancy payment by reason of being laid off or kept on short-time.
elements.quote: is eligible for a redundancy payment by reason of being laid off or kept on short-time

elements.requirement: The employer's obligation under subsection (1) to pay a redundancy payment has effect subject to the following provisions of that Part, including in particular sections 140 to 144, 149 to 152, 155 to 161 and 164.
elements.quote: Subsection (1) has effect subject to the following provisions of this Part (including, in particular, sections 140 to 144, 149 to 152, 155 to 161 and 164)
